textobanner: Learn more about me and discover how I can assist you by turning challenges into solutions.
textosobremimum: Full Stack Developer, active since 2022 in the development and maintenance of portals and systems for government projects, using the HCL DX (Digital Experience) platform.
textosobremimdois: In my day-to-day work, I build solutions by integrating Java and Spring Boot on the back-end with JavaScript and React on the front-end, while also working with tools such as HCL DX, Foundry, and HCL Leap. I also have a background in technical support and WordPress website development.
projetoscomerciaistitulo: Projects that transform ideas into real solutions.
projetoscomerciaistexto: Below are 3 large-scale projects in which I actively participated, contributing to every stage of the development cycle with a focus on performance, scalability, and user experience.
textospmaisdigital: The 'São Paulo Mais Digital' (More Digital São Paulo) project was created with the goal of serving as a central hub for users, consolidating services from Poupatempo, DetranSP, Sabesp, and other entities within the State of São Paulo.
textocms: The CMS is designed to help all autonomous government agencies (autarquias) in the State of São Paulo achieve digital freedom, enabling them to develop their own websites in accordance with the State of São Paulo’s style guide while still maintaining their own unique visual identity.
textoalesp: Given the ongoing shifts in technology, the Legislative Assembly of the State of São Paulo (Alesp) determined that it was time to modernize its infrastructure and visual identity; consequently, it undertook the restructuring of its website, intranet, and transparency portal.
